body.heading: Where in the world is State of Palestine?
paragraphs: State of Palestine is a country in Western Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: Two parts, one country
paragraphs: The State of Palestine is made of two areas. The West Bank lies west of the Jordan River, and the Gaza Strip lies along the Mediterranean Sea. Palestinian government offices are based in the city of Ramallah, in the West Bank.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in State of Palestine is Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of State of Palestine is the Israeli new shekel. In the West Bank, people also use the Jordanian dinar for bigger payments and savings.

body.heading: How big is State of Palestine?
paragraphs: State of Palestine covers about 6,020 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Qatar.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Bethlehem is famous around the world as the birthplace of Jesus. Its Church of the Nativity is one of the oldest churches anywhere, and Manger Square buzzes with markets and cafés.
Jericho is one of the oldest cities on Earth and the lowest — below sea level! A cable car climbs to the Mount of Temptation above its palm groves and orchards.
